name: outage-log
title: Keep an incident log as it happens
description: Appends each step to the incident log through the safe queue, makes a task for the fix, and writes the shift-change handoff.
say: We had an outage; keep the log as we go.

inputs.name: project
inputs.prompt: Which project keeps the incident log?

inputs.name: entry
inputs.prompt: What happened, in a few sentences?

inputs.name: fix
inputs.prompt: What is the follow-up fix, in one line?

steps.title: Add it to the incident log
Make a task for the fix
Write the shift-change handoff
steps.prompt: Write the handoff for the next on-call with /gt:gt-create handoff: what happened ({{inputs.entry}}), what is done, what is still open ({{inputs.fix}}) and how to roll back if there is a rollback.
